key_insight: The paper scales end-to-end learning of safe feedback controllers by turning the CBF safety filter into a differentiable optimization layer and training it efficiently with operator splitting plus Jacobian-Free Backpropagation.
engineering_relevance: This enables practical high-dimensional control for safety-critical systems, preserving hard safety constraints while extending learned feedback control to multi-agent problems far beyond prior low-dimensional limits.
method: Embed a quadratic-program CBF safety filter as an optimization layer.
Use operator splitting to make the safety layer scalable.
Apply Jacobian-Free Backpropagation for efficient end-to-end training without explicit Jacobians.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful validation on high-dimensional multi-agent nonlinear control problems with state dimension up to 1200 and control dimension up to 400.
watch_item: The approach still depends on accurately formulated CBF constraints and a numerically stable QP/solver pipeline, which may be sensitive in real-time deployment.
paper_title: End-to-End Learning of Safe Optimal Feedback Control in High Dimensions with Control Barrier Function Layers
